contract.nonempty: exact greatest represented word <= bound, excluding zero when requested
contract.empty: source minimum-value return with proof of the empty branch; value equality alone is not an emptiness test
contract.caller: tightening the upper bound preserves intersection with every additional lower bound

native_bindings.shims: Exact preceding CodeUtil/base-class native semantics; source bridge is restricted, not a formal Java compiler

sweep.traversal: bits-1 down to 0; sign is fixed by optional mask

conclusion.inputs: all fixed-sign mask cylinders and all signed bounds
conclusion.theorem: For every x in the cylinder with x <= bound, the source output y is in the cylinder, y <= bound, and x <= y.
conclusion.induction: Empty suffix, every nonsign column, then exactly one sign column

order_certificate.conclusion: Every value branch returns a feasible word. Every feasible candidate is <= the returned value. Every empty-sentinel branch has no feasible candidate.
order_certificate.transfer: Replacing the upper bound by this value, or returning empty on its proved empty branch, preserves intersection with any additional lower bound.
